subject: Chemistry
title: Aldol Condensation: The Alpha Hydrogen Key
summary: Two small ethanal molecules join into one bigger molecule. How the alpha hydrogen makes it happen, and which compounds cannot do it.

notes.title: 10 – Aldol Condensation: The Alpha Hydrogen Key

keyPoints: The **alpha carbon** is the carbon next to the carbonyl carbon; an H on it is an **alpha hydrogen**.
**Dilute NaOH** removes an alpha H, giving an **enolate ion**.
The enolate attacks the carbonyl carbon of a second molecule: a **nucleophilic addition**.
No alpha hydrogen, no aldol: **methanal and benzaldehyde** do not react this way.
